plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Early Childhood Education for Transfer AS-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8049/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 60 = 15+16+16+13 (all semester headers match their rows; verified). ECE 312 requires eligibility for ENGL C1000 (eligibility/placement, documented here, not encoded as a course prerequisite). ECE 320 requires ECE 300, ECE 312, and co-requisite ECE 326 (same semester; all encoded), plus TB clearance and proof of immunization (non-course requirements; documented here, not encoded). ECE 321 requires ECE 300, 312, 320, and 326, plus TB clearance and proof of immunization (documented here, not encoded). CalGETC Area 4 footnote: a total of 6 units from 2 disciplines is required (ECE 312 and ECE 314 in Semester 1 plus one Area 4 course in Semester 4). Semester 4 transferable elective footnote references 'List A or B' though no lists appear in this map (transcribed as printed); units needed to total 60 for graduation. This map also meets the Certificate of Proficiency in Early Childhood Education, Associate Teacher (no separate sequence published). CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
